name: Diverge-then-Converge Brainstorm
description: Blueprint 13 of 96 (design card BP-BRN-02, 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md:737). MECHANISM: a HARD temporal barrier between unjudged generation and judgement. N divergers generate blind to each other and blind to the scoring criteria; the barrier freezes and hashes the idea set; the convergence council may score, shortlist and reject but is contractually FORBIDDEN from adding an idea. The barrier is the whole contribution - superpowers:brainstorming blends exploration with judgement, and a council assumes the options already exist.

intent.description: The thing being scoped, in one sentence. S0 rewrites it; a bad frame poisons both halves.

constraints.description: Known constraints. NOT shown to the divergers - a constraint list is a judgement criterion and leaks the convergence frame into generation.

divergence_lenses.description: One blind diverger per lens. The fan-out key.

shortlist_target.description: How many survivors the convergence council should hand the owner.

convergence_protocol.description: Which council preset scores the frozen set.

framer.description: Rewrites the intent into one falsifiable sentence and states what would count as a good answer, WITHOUT proposing any answer

diverger.description: Generates ideas under one lens, blind to every sibling and blind to the scoring criteria; never self-censors on feasibility

convergence-chair.description: Chairs the convergence council, enforces the no-new-ideas contract and logs any breach as a process violation

owner.description: The human owner - receives the shortlist and the open questions, and is the only escalation target

stages.title: S0 FRAME the intent in one falsifiable sentence

work_unit.title: Frame the brainstorm intent and define what a good answer looks like
work_unit.question_or_target: Rewrite the owner intent as one falsifiable sentence plus an explicit statement of what would make an answer good, proposing zero answers.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a bad frame poisons both halves, so this is not a cheap step

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the frame quotes the owner intent verbatim and names at least one thing that would make an answer BAD, so the criterion is falsifiable rather than aspirational
tests_required: a frame that contains a candidate answer is rejected by the no-answers check
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the convergence chair reads the frame before the council opens and may return it once
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WBRN-0201 emitted only when frame.json exists, parses, carries one_sentence + good_answer_criteria + bad_answer_criteria, and contains no candidate answer; otherwise FAILED:WBRN-0201 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to an owner clarification rather than a third reframe

stages.title: S1 DIVERGE - one blind generator per lens, no scoring criteria in the prompt

body.title: Generate ideas under exactly one lens

work_unit.title: Generate unjudged ideas under one assigned lens
work_unit.question_or_target: Under the assigned lens only, generate ideas for the framed intent. Do not rank, do not filter on feasibility, do not read any sibling output.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: generation quality is the product here

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every idea names the lens that produced it and is stated concretely enough that the convergence council can reject it for a specific reason
tests_required: a diverger prompt that contains any scoring criterion fails the prompt-purity check
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: no reviewer during divergence - review is what the barrier defers
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WBRN-0202 emitted per lens when the lens artifact exists, parses, and carries at least one idea; a lens that returns nothing emits FAILED:WBRN-0202 null-lens and is recorded, not hidden
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry with the lens restated inline, then record a null lens and proceed on the survivors

stages.title: S2 BARRIER - freeze and hash the idea set; nothing may be added after this point
S2b The barrier is HARD - assert the freeze happened before any judgement ran
S3 CONVERGE - council scores and shortlists the FROZEN set and may not add an idea
S3b Every rejection carries a reason, or the convergence is not done
S4 EMIT the shortlist plus the open questions for the owner

work_unit.title: Emit the shortlist, the reasoned rejections and the open questions
work_unit.question_or_target: Emit the owner-facing result: shortlist with rationale, every rejection with its reason, and the open questions that the brainstorm could not settle.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the chair owns the no-new-ideas contract and must not delegate the emission

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every shortlisted item cites the lens artifact it came from; every open question names what would settle it
tests_required: a shortlist item with no source lens artifact fails the provenance check
both-states control: inject an idea that exists only in the convergence transcript and confirm the provenance check FAILS on it and PASSES once removed
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reader who did not sit on the convergence council confirms every shortlist item traces to a frozen idea
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:WBRN-0205 emitted when shortlist.json exists, parses, every item traces to the frozen set, and every rejection carries a reason; otherwise FAILED:WBRN-0205 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: escalate the untraceable item to the owner rather than dropping it silently

stages.title: S4b The run is only complete if the owner got something actionable OR an explicit open question

impact.blast_radius: writes only under command-center/brainstorm/bp-brn-02/**; no network, no shell

x_extensions.distinct_mechanism: hard temporal barrier + hash-frozen idea set + a convergence phase contractually forbidden from adding ideas
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: BP-BRN-01 separates peers by VENDOR; this separates generation from judgement in TIME and works entirely in-vendor. BP-REQ-01 also brainstorms then converges, but its convergence is a serial human one-question loop, not an automated council over a frozen set.
contraindications: the requirement is already specified - go straight to planning
a binary go/no-go - that is a council alone with no divergence phase

worked_examples.name: scope the receipt-schema substrate before building it

params.intent: Decide how catalogued work units should reach a schema-valid receipt when the declared schema directory does not exist
constraints: the catalog file must stay byte-identical

worked_examples.walkthrough: S0 reframes the intent and states that a good answer names ONE control plane. S1 runs 4 blind divergers: first-principles proposes a resolver over a generated shim tree; cheapest-possible proposes rewriting the catalog paths; most-ambitious proposes a schema registry service; failure-first proposes leaving it dangling but failing closed. S2 freezes 4 lens artifacts and records the set hash. S3's council rejects the catalog rewrite (violates the byte-identical constraint - reason recorded) and the registry service (new runtime - reason recorded), and shortlists the shim-tree resolver. S4 emits the shortlist plus one open question: who regenerates the shims when the catalog changes.

worked_examples.name: negative control - an idea injected only into the convergence prompt

params.intent: Decide how catalogued work units should reach a schema-valid receipt

worked_examples.walkthrough: The convergence prompt is seeded with a strong idea that appears in no lens artifact. The council shortlists it. The stopping rule out-of-contract-idea fires (ideas_added_after_barrier == 1), the barrier-integrity gate fails, and the run escalates instead of shipping a shortlist whose best item has no provenance. This is the benchmark case named on the design card and it is what makes the barrier load-bearing rather than decorative.

benchmark_cases: inject a strong idea only into the convergence prompt - it must be rejected as out-of-contract
a scope with one obvious answer - expect a short diverge phase and a fast shortlist, not manufactured breadth
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED that the barrier measurably increases shortlist diversity; the settling experiment is to run the same intent blended (no barrier) and barriered and compare shortlist diversity. Confidence: likely (55-80%).

council_metric_binding.novel_ideas: INSIDE the convergence council this registry metric counts ideas that are NOT members of the frozen set - so novel_ideas >= 1 IS the barrier breach. Bound this way on purpose: `custom:ideas_added_after_barrier` parses under councilspec but is a DSL-SEM-007 VIOLATION in platform/lib/wfdsl/expr.py (the ':' is not in its lexer), so only registry metric names satisfy BOTH implementations.
council_metric_binding.no_new_idea_rounds: quiet rounds in the convergence council - the scoring has stopped moving
council_metric_binding.objections_open: a rejection without a reason is carried as an open objection, so objections_open == 0 is the reasoned-rejection condition expressed in registry terms
